sentences.text: Heading is the direction the bow is pointing at this moment, which wanders as the boat yaws.
Course is the direction you intend to steer.
Track, or course over ground on a GPS, is the direction the boat actually moves over the bottom, which differs from heading when wind and current push you sideways.
Speed over ground is your actual speed over the bottom, as opposed to speed through the water.
A bearing is the direction from your boat to an object, and it can be true, magnetic, compass or relative.
